meta.text_method: TF-IDF with English stop-word removal, sublinear term frequency, unigrams, and L2 normalization

embedding.pooling: Mean of last-layer token hidden states over page tokens, excluding special tokens, weighted across chunks by token count, then L2-normalized.
embedding.preprocessing: Full page text with whitespace collapsed, matching the TF-IDF input; no stop-word removal.
embedding.chunking: All model tokens are retained in non-overlapping chunks of at most 254 content tokens; each chunk gets model special tokens. Chunk vectors are combined as a content-token-weighted mean.

null.definition: Mean TF-IDF cosine similarity across the fixed supplied directed edges, compared with 999 random permutations of page-to-node assignments.
